    engine.publish(lease2, time.time(), {"output": "second"})
    
    # Check results in submission order
    results = engine.results("owner1")
    assert len(results) == 2
    assert results[0]["output"] == "first"
    assert results[1]["output"] == "second"

        threads.append(t)
